name: Eve Energy (Matter) Smart Plug & Power Meter

radios.note: Eve lists Thread. Some CSA listings for Eve Energy variants also show Bluetooth, but we could not confirm it for this US unit.

matter.note: CSA listing for family SKU 20EBU4101. Eve's identification page names this version 'U.S. & Canada, 4th generation / Matter'.

apple_home.note: Through Matter. Needs an Apple home hub that is also a Thread border router (HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen, or Apple TV 4K with Thread).

google_home.note: Through Matter. Needs a Google Nest hub that acts as a Thread border router.

alexa.note: Through Matter. Needs an Echo device that works as a Matter controller and Thread border router.

smartthings.note: Through Matter. Needs a SmartThings hub with Thread.

home_assistant.note: Through the Home Assistant Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router on the network.

hubRequired.note: Needs a Matter controller that is also a Thread border router. Eve sells no bridge of its own; the hub comes from your ecosystem.

localControl.note: Matter over Thread works on the local network, with no Eve cloud or account.

energyMonitoring.note: Built-in power meter. A firmware update adds Matter energy reporting for Apple Home, Google Home, Home Assistant and SmartThings; Eve does not name Alexa there.

maxLoadWatts.note: 120 V, 60 Hz, max. 15 A / 1,800 W (U.S. & Canada).

summary: Eve Energy is a smart plug with a built-in power meter that connects over Thread and is controlled through Matter. The US and Canada version (model 20EBU4101) is rated 15 A / 1,800 W. Eve lists Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant as supported, and it works locally with no Eve account or cloud.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router that is also a Matter controller, such as a HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K with Thread, a Nest hub or a Thread-capable Echo.
Older Eve Energy US units share model number 20EBU4101; the Matter version is product number 10EBU4151, so check the box before buying used.
Eve does not list Alexa among the controllers that show Matter energy readings.
